propositions: Bridge preview/sync must become the primary vocabulary while retaining all legacy reconcile entrypoints (CLI, direct-engine, library, MCP, workflow) with their original defaults and filtering semantics unchanged.

Legacy --mode and --filter-local-ids flags must remain supported with post-differ write filtering; canonical --only/--except must narrow differ inputs before examination; both filter paths must coexist without collision.
Every unresolvable --only/--except token and every selection that disappears between preflight and locked load must exit 2 before lock acquisition or mutation, naming all missing identifiers.
Capped live sync (--max-changes 10/100) must retain deterministic applied/deferred manifests; uncapped live must delete its temporary manifest; uncapped legacy bootstrap must remain unchanged.
ADR 0092 must document the expand-contract adapter rationale, be reserved and indexed, and link from architecture and release notes following repository convention.

Real entrypoint tests must cover legacy CLI dry-run default, direct-engine live default, library reconcile(mode=...) behavior, workflow rollback mapping, and external-DC helper continuity without collapsing distinct no-argument defaults.
